query:
INSERT INTO productCompositions (parentProductId, childProductId, quantity) 
SELECT 
  (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'Dose Tanqueray' AND name NOT LIKE '%Teste%' LIMIT 1),
  id,
  CASE 
    WHEN name = 'Tanqueray Dry 750ml' THEN 0.150
    WHEN name = 'Copo Ultra 700ml' THEN 1.000
    WHEN name = 'Coko Maracuja 200ml' THEN 0.333
    WHEN name = 'Coko Melancia 200ml' THEN 0.333
    WHEN name = 'Coko Morango 200ml' THEN 0.334
    WHEN name = 'Red Bull Melancia 250ml' THEN 0.333
    WHEN name LIKE 'Red Bull Morango%250ml' THEN 0.334
    WHEN name = 'Red Bull Tropical 250ml' THEN 0.333
  END as quantity
FROM products
WHERE name IN (
  'Tanqueray Dry 750ml',
  'Copo Ultra 700ml',
  'Coko Maracuja 200ml',
  'Coko Melancia 200ml',
  'Coko Morango 200ml',
  'Red Bull Melancia 250ml',
  'Red Bull Morango e Pêssego 250ml',
  'Red Bull Tropical 250ml'
)
